description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeeAllowedReportToEmployeeModel' within the OrangeHRM system. The class models specific employee data for API serialization, including attributes like employee number, name, employee ID, and termination ID. It implements normalization for API responses and uses traits to assist in serialization. The class constructor initializes the model with an Employee entity and sets relevant filters and attribute names.
